subject: MAP weekly checkpoint — pricing & budget unblock
messages:
From: Elaine Foster <elaine.foster@acmelogistics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@acmelogistics.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 21:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP weekly checkpoint — pricing & credit ask

Karthik / Neha —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier this week. I wanted to summarize where we are on the MAP and flag the budget constraint that’s blocking our procurement committee. High level: the execs like the technical evaluation results, but they’ve capped any new vendor commit to a fiscal Q3 budget line unless we can reduce first-year spend by at least 18%.

We _really_ want to move forward with Redwood — performance and the integration look good — but we need help on the economics to push this through procurement. Specifically:
- Request: one-time onboarding credit + 12% list discount on the committed capacity for year one.
- Committed sizing the team is prepared to consider: 100–150k tokens/day (starter roll). We could sign a 12-month commitment if terms meet the budget ask.
- Timing: procurement will reconvene on July 24 to approve spend. We need internal sign-off (legal/finance) before that meeting to get onto the agenda.

I attached our latest MAP workbook (MAP_v3.xlsx) with milestone dates and evaluation criteria. Can you confirm the approval path at Redwood and whether a one-time credit + discount is feasible? Also let me know if you want us to provide a firm commit range for finance.

Best,
Elaine Foster
Director, Cloud Procurement
Acme Logistics Inc.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (Excel workbook, 180KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Foster <elaine.foster@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly checkpoint — pricing & credit ask

Elaine —

Really appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Quick read of the MAP looks good and the commit range you shared is helpful. We can move internally on a proposal but I want to be explicit about the approvals we need: finance sign-off for one-time onboarding credits, and a sales director approval for an above-standard discount. I’ve looped in Marissa from finance to give an initial sense of feasibility.

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
1) Marissa to confirm the maximum one-time onboarding credit we can offer for a deal at this scale (today).
2) Neha and I to prepare a short commercial term sheet showing: list vs proposed discount, estimated annual spend at the 100/150k token/day band, and estimated monthly invoicing cadence.
3) Internal approvals targeted by: July 23 EOD so you can hit procurement on July 24.

Can you confirm a firm commit range by Monday EOD (July 21) and whether the procurement meeting on the 24th is fixed?

Thanks — I’ll try to get the initial numbers to you before Monday afternoon.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0172
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly checkpoint — pricing & credit ask

Karthik / Neha —

Reviewed Elaine’s MAP and the attached usage assumptions. High level: finance can support a one-time onboarding credit plus a temporary list discount, but approval depends on a few items we need from the buyer:

Requirements for finance approval:
- Firm committed minimum for first 6 months (USD/month) — we need a guaranteed floor to model cash flow. Preferably $60k+/mo for the 12-month term; at 100k tokens/day that roughly maps to the lower bound but please confirm exact token-to-dollar mapping.
- A signed mutual action plan with milestone payments (onboarding, integration sign-off, production cutover) — this lets us time credit recognition.
- For procurement: a short commercial term sheet (2 pages) with the proposed credit, discount, and a risk-adjusted ARR estimate.

Provisional financial yardstick I can take to leadership today: up to a $50k one-time onboarding credit for deals that hit >= $720k ARR (12-month committed run-rate), plus up to a 10% standard discount. Anything above 10% needs director approval and written justification. If the team can commit to a $60k+/mo minimum, I’ll escalate for the extra 2% (to reach the 12% Elaine asked for) but it’s not guaranteed.

I’ve attached the internal pricing sheet that maps token bands to expected monthly spend for our standard plans (pricing-sheet.pdf). Karthik — if you can get a confirmed commit range from Acme by EOD Monday, I’ll prepare the term sheet and kick off the approval flow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing-sheet.pdf (PDF, 95KB)
From: Elaine Foster <elaine.foster@acmelogistics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@acmelogistics.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 16:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly checkpoint — pricing & credit ask

Karthik / Marissa / Neha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the clarity, Marissa. Procurement is comfortable moving this to the approval queue if we can give them a committed floor. Our execs have authorized a target of $65k/month for the first 6 months (they can flex to $70k if Redwood confirms the additional 2% discount). We can commit to a 12-month term with milestone-linked payments.

Action items from our side:
- I’ll share a signed MAP with milestone dates by EOD Wednesday.
- Procurement asks for the 2-page term sheet and the proposed credit in writing (DocuSign preferred) so they can include it in the packet for the July 24 meeting.

If you can prepare the term sheet and a DocuSign draft by end of day Wednesday (Jul 23 Pacific), we’ll put it on the procurement agenda for the 24th.

On the call: please include someone from legal if we need any exceptions on payment terms.

Best,
Elaine
Director, Cloud Procurement
Acme Logistics Inc.
